Expected Outcomes  预期成果

At the end of the lectures on MOS capacitors, you should be able to:
在 MOS 电容器讲座结束时，您应该能够：
◻ ◻ ◻\square Explain the effects of gate bias on the charge in the MOS capacitor, hence the concepts of accumulation, depletion and inversion;
◻ ◻ ◻\square 解释栅极偏压对 MOS 电容器中电荷的影响，从而引出积累、耗尽和反转的概念；
◻ ◻ ◻\square Draw the energy band diagram of the MOS capacitor at equilibrium and under different bias regimes;
◻ ◻ ◻\square 绘制 MOS 电容器在平衡状态及不同偏置条件下的能带图；
◻ ◻ ◻\square Perform simple analysis such as the calculation of the depletion layer width, flat band voltage, threshold voltage;
◻ ◻ ◻\square 进行简单分析，如计算耗尽层宽度、平带电压、阈值电压；
◻ ◻ ◻\square Sketch the C-V characteristics and relate the different parts of the curve to the different bias regimes of the MOS Capacitor.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 绘制 C-V 特性曲线，并将曲线的不同部分与 MOS 电容器的不同偏置状态联系起来。

1. Ideal MOS Capacitor
1. 理想 MOS 电容器

Basic assumptions for the ideal MOS capacitor :
理想 MOS 电容器的基本假设：

  1. The oxide is a perfect insulator.
    氧化层是一个完美的绝缘体。
  2. There are no charges in the oxide or at the oxide-semiconductor interface. [ 1 ] [ 1 ] ^([1]){ }^{[1]}
    氧化层或氧化物-半导体界面处没有电荷。 [ 1 ] [ 1 ] ^([1]){ }^{[1]}

    [1] This is the basis of the assumption that under any biasing condition the amount of charge on the metal adjacent to the oxide is equal to the amount of the induced charge in the semiconductor but with opposite signs. The case where there are charges in the oxide or at the oxide-semiconductor interface will be considered later.
    [1] 这是基于这样一个假设：在任何偏置条件下，金属邻近氧化层的电荷量等于半导体中感应电荷的量，但符号相反。含有氧化层或氧化物-半导体界面电荷的情况将在后面讨论。
  3. When V G = 0 V G = 0 V_(G)=0\mathbf{V}_{\mathbf{G}}=\mathbf{0}, the energy difference between the metal work function Φ m Φ m Phi_(m)\Phi_{\mathrm{m}} and the semiconductor work function Φ s Φ s Phi_(s)\Phi_{\mathrm{s}} is zero, i.e., Φ ms = 0 Φ ms = 0 Phi_(ms)=0\Phi_{\mathrm{ms}}=0. [ 2 ] [ 2 ] ^([2]){ }^{[2]} All the energy bands are flat.
    当 V G = 0 V G = 0 V_(G)=0\mathbf{V}_{\mathbf{G}}=\mathbf{0} 时，金属功函数 Φ m Φ m Phi_(m)\Phi_{\mathrm{m}} 与半导体功函数 Φ s Φ s Phi_(s)\Phi_{\mathrm{s}} 之间的能量差为零，即 Φ ms = 0 Φ ms = 0 Phi_(ms)=0\Phi_{\mathrm{ms}}=0 。 [ 2 ] [ 2 ] ^([2]){ }^{[2]} 所有能带都是平坦的。

    [2] This assumption is generally not true in real MOS devices. It has only been made at this point to make the description of the static behavior of MOS capacitor simpler, in order to aid out initial understanding of the MOS system. This condition will be relaxed later.
    [2] 这个假设在实际的 MOS 器件中通常不成立。此处仅为简化 MOS 电容器静态行为的描述，以帮助我们初步理解 MOS 系统而做出。这个条件以后会放宽。

2. MOS Capacitor Under DC Bias (p-type silicon substrate)
2. 直流偏压下的 MOS 电容器（p 型硅基底）

2.1 Accumulation ( V G < 0 V G < 0 V_(G) < 0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}}<0 )
2.1 积累（ V G < 0 V G < 0 V_(G) < 0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}}<0 ）



◻ ◻ ◻\square Negative charges supplied to the gate by the external bias should be balanced by positive charges on the silicon side. Therefore, holes at the silicon surface are induced and the surface of the silicon becomes more p-type.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由外部偏压提供给栅极的负电荷应被硅侧的正电荷所平衡。因此，在硅表面会诱导出空穴，硅表面变得更具 p 型特性。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Since the hole in p-type silicon is the majority carrier and the hole concentration at the interface is higher than that in the silicon substrate, this is a situation of majority carrier “accumulation” condition.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由于 p 型硅中的空穴是多数载流子，且界面处的空穴浓度高于硅基底中的浓度，因此这是多数载流子“积累”状态。

◻ ◻ ◻\square When V G V G V_(G)\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}} is negative, the energy bands in the bulk (interior) of the silicon move downwards, relative to E F E F E_(F)E_{F} in the metal. This results in the bands bending upwards at the Si / SiO 2 Si / SiO 2 Si//SiO_(2)\mathrm{Si} / \mathrm{SiO}_{2} interface.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当 V G V G V_(G)\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}} 为负时，硅体（内部）中的能带相对于金属中的 E F E F E_(F)E_{F} 向下移动。这导致能带在 Si / SiO 2 Si / SiO 2 Si//SiO_(2)\mathrm{Si} / \mathrm{SiO}_{2} 界面处向上弯曲。
◻ ◻ ◻\square But, for an ideal MOS capacitor, no steady state current flows as the oxide is a perfect insulator → → rarr\rightarrow Fermi level in the silicon remains constant (flat).
◻ ◻ ◻\square 但是，对于理想的 MOS 电容器，由于氧化层是完美的绝缘体，没有稳态电流流动， → → rarr\rightarrow 硅中的费米能级保持恒定（平坦）。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Hole concentration : p = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E i − E F ) / k T ] p = n i exp ⁡ E i − E F / k T p=n_(i)exp[(E_(i)-E_(F))//kT]p=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) / k T\right]
◻ ◻ ◻\square 空穴浓度： p = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E i − E F ) / k T ] p = n i exp ⁡ E i − E F / k T p=n_(i)exp[(E_(i)-E_(F))//kT]p=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) / k T\right]
◻ ◻ ◻\square As ( E i − E F ) E i − E F (E_(i)-E_(F))\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) is larger at the surface than in the bulk, there are more holes (majority carriers) at the surface than in the bulk → → rarr\rightarrow accumulation.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由于表面处的 ( E i − E F ) E i − E F (E_(i)-E_(F))\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) 比体内更大，表面上的空穴（多数载流子）比体内更多，称为 → → rarr\rightarrow 积累。

2.2 Depletion ( V G > 0 V G > 0 V_(G) > 0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}}>0 )
2.2 耗尽（ V G > 0 V G > 0 V_(G) > 0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}}>0 ）


◻ ◻ ◻\square Positive charges supplied to the gate repel the free holes in silicon away from the Si / SiO 2 Si / SiO 2 Si//SiO2\mathrm{Si} / \mathrm{SiO} 2 interface, which leave behind un-compensated ionized acceptors in the depletion region in the silicon.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 施加到栅极的正电荷将硅中的自由空穴从 Si / SiO 2 Si / SiO 2 Si//SiO2\mathrm{Si} / \mathrm{SiO} 2 界面排斥开，留下耗尽区内未被补偿的电离受主离子。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The MOS capacitor is said to be in the “Depletion” condition.
◻ ◻ ◻\square MOS 电容器处于“耗尽”状态。

◻ ◻ ◻\square When V G > 0 V G > 0 V_(G) > 0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}}>0, the energy bands in the bulk (interior) of the silicon move upwards, relative to E F E F E_(F)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}} in the metal. This results in the bands bending downwards at the Si / SiO 2 Si / SiO 2 Si//SiO_(2)\mathrm{Si} / \mathrm{SiO}_{2} interface.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当 V G > 0 V G > 0 V_(G) > 0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}}>0 时，硅的体内（内部）能带相对于金属中的 E F E F E_(F)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}} 向上移动。这导致能带在 Si / SiO 2 Si / SiO 2 Si//SiO_(2)\mathrm{Si} / \mathrm{SiO}_{2} 界面处向下弯曲。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Hole concentration: p = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E i − E F ) / k T ] p = n i exp ⁡ E i − E F / k T p=n_(i)exp[(E_(i)-E_(F))//kT]p=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) / k T\right]
◻ ◻ ◻\square 空穴浓度： p = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E i − E F ) / k T ] p = n i exp ⁡ E i − E F / k T p=n_(i)exp[(E_(i)-E_(F))//kT]p=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) / k T\right]
◻ ( E i − E F ) ◻ E i − E F ◻(E_(i)-E_(F))\square\left(\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{i}}-\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}}\right) is smaller at the surface than in the bulk, thus indicating that holes are depleted at the surface.
◻ ( E i − E F ) ◻ E i − E F ◻(E_(i)-E_(F))\square\left(\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{i}}-\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}}\right) 在表面处小于体内，表明表面处空穴被耗尽。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The space charge in the depletion layer, per unit area, Q D = − e N A W Q D = − e N A W Q_(D)=-eN_(A)WQ_{D}=-e N_{A} W where N A N A N_(A)\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{A}} : doping concentration, W : depletion layer width.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 耗尽层中的空间电荷，单位面积为 Q D = − e N A W Q D = − e N A W Q_(D)=-eN_(A)WQ_{D}=-e N_{A} W ，其中 N A N A N_(A)\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{A}} ：掺杂浓度，W ：耗尽层宽度。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Since the positive charge at the gate side should be balanced by the space charge Q D Q D Q_(D)Q_{D} in the depletion region, → → rarr\rightarrow increase of ∨ G ∨ G vv_(G)\vee_{G} (more positive charges at the gate) will increase W W WW (more negative charges in the depletion region)
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由于栅极侧的正电荷应由耗尽区的空间电荷 Q D Q D Q_(D)Q_{D} 平衡， → → rarr\rightarrow 增加 ∨ G ∨ G vv_(G)\vee_{G} （栅极上更多的正电荷）将增加 W W WW （耗尽区中更多的负电荷）

2.3 Inversion: When a large positive bias is applied ( V G ≫ 0 V G ≫ 0 V_(G)≫0V_{G} \gg 0 )
2.3 反转：当施加较大正偏压时（ V G ≫ 0 V G ≫ 0 V_(G)≫0V_{G} \gg 0 ）

MOS Capacitor in Inversion Mode
MOS 电容器在反转模式下

◻ ◻ ◻\square Electrons and holes are thermally generated in the depletion layer. The E-field in the depletion layer causes the holes to go into interior (bulk), and the electrons to collect in a thin layer near the silicon-oxide interface.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 电子和空穴在耗尽层中热生成。耗尽层中的电场使空穴进入内部（体区），电子则聚集在硅-氧化物界面附近的薄层中。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The MOS capacitor is said to be in the “Inversion” condition, because the surface layer contain more electrons than holes even though the semiconductor is p-type.
◻ ◻ ◻\square MOS 电容被称为处于“反转”状态，因为表面层含有的电子比空穴多，尽管半导体是 p 型的。
When V G ≫ 0 V G ≫ 0 V_(G)≫0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}} \gg 0, the energy bands at the surface of the silicon bend downwards even more, so that the intrinsic Fermi level E i E i E_(i)E_{i} at the surface crosses over the Fermi level E F E F E_(F)E_{F}. Near the surface, E F − E i > 0 E F − E i > 0 E_(F)-E_(i) > 0E_{F}-E_{i}>0.
当 V G ≫ 0 V G ≫ 0 V_(G)≫0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}} \gg 0 时，硅表面的能带向下弯曲更多，以至于本征费米能级 E i E i E_(i)E_{i} 在表面超过了费米能级 E F E F E_(F)E_{F} 。在表面附近， E F − E i > 0 E F − E i > 0 E_(F)-E_(i) > 0E_{F}-E_{i}>0 。
As n = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E F − E i ) / k T ] n = n i exp ⁡ E F − E i / k T quad n=n_(i)exp[(E_(F)-E_(i))//kT]\quad n=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{F}-E_{i}\right) / k T\right] and p = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E i − E F ) / k T ] p = n i exp ⁡ E i − E F / k T p=n_(i)exp[(E_(i)-E_(F))//kT]p=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) / k T\right], so, n > p n > p n > pn>p.
当 n = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E F − E i ) / k T ] n = n i exp ⁡ E F − E i / k T quad n=n_(i)exp[(E_(F)-E_(i))//kT]\quad n=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{F}-E_{i}\right) / k T\right] 和 p = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E i − E F ) / k T ] p = n i exp ⁡ E i − E F / k T p=n_(i)exp[(E_(i)-E_(F))//kT]p=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) / k T\right] 时，因此， n > p n > p n > pn>p 。
The number of minority carriers (electrons) is greater than the number of majority carriers (holes) near the surface. The surface is thus inverted.
少数载流子（电子）的数量在表面附近多于多数载流子（空穴）。因此，表面被反转。
The positive charges on the gate are balanced by the silicon charge, Q s i = Q n + Q D Q s i = Q n + Q D Q_(si)=Q_(n)+Q_(D)Q_{s i}=Q_{n}+Q_{D}, where Q n Q n Q_(n)\mathrm{Q}_{\mathrm{n}} is the inversion charge (made up of electrons), and the depletion charge, Q D = Q D = Q_(D)=\mathrm{Q}_{\mathrm{D}}= − e N A W m − e N A W m -eN_(A)W_(m)-e N_{A} W_{m} (made up of ionized acceptors).
门上的正电荷由硅电荷平衡， Q s i = Q n + Q D Q s i = Q n + Q D Q_(si)=Q_(n)+Q_(D)Q_{s i}=Q_{n}+Q_{D} ，其中 Q n Q n Q_(n)\mathrm{Q}_{\mathrm{n}} 是反转电荷（由电子组成）， Q D = Q D = Q_(D)=\mathrm{Q}_{\mathrm{D}}= − e N A W m − e N A W m -eN_(A)W_(m)-e N_{A} W_{m} 是耗尽电荷（由电离受主组成）。

There are two types of inversion :
反转有两种类型：

  1. Weak inversion:  弱反转：
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square The electron concentration at the Si / SiO 2 Si / SiO 2 Si//SiO_(2)\mathrm{Si} / \mathrm{SiO}_{2} interface is not high. Further increase in gate charge is balanced by increase in both Q n & Q D Q n & Q D Q_(n)&Q_(D)Q_{n} \& Q_{D}. → → rarr\rightarrow depletion layer width still increases with increasing ∨ G ∨ G vv_(G)\vee_{G}.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 在 Si / SiO 2 Si / SiO 2 Si//SiO_(2)\mathrm{Si} / \mathrm{SiO}_{2} 界面的电子浓度不高。门电荷的进一步增加由 Q n & Q D Q n & Q D Q_(n)&Q_(D)Q_{n} \& Q_{D} 的增加平衡。 → → rarr\rightarrow 耗尽层宽度随着 ∨ G ∨ G vv_(G)\vee_{G} 的增加仍在增加。

2. Strong inversion:  2. 强反转：

◻ ◻ ◻\square The electron concentration ( n s ) n s (n_(s))\left(n_{s}\right) at the interface is greater than hole concentration ( p b ) p b (p_(b))\left(p_{b}\right) in the bulk.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 界面处的电子浓度 ( n s ) n s (n_(s))\left(n_{s}\right) 大于体内的空穴浓度 ( p b ) p b (p_(b))\left(p_{b}\right) 。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Since n = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E F − E i ) / k T ] n = n i exp ⁡ E F − E i / k T n=n_(i)exp[(E_(F)-E_(i))//kT]n=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{F}-E_{i}\right) / k T\right] and p = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E i − E F ) / k T ] p = n i exp ⁡ E i − E F / k T p=n_(i)exp[(E_(i)-E_(F))//kT]p=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) / k T\right], ( E F − E i E F − E i E_(F)-E_(i)E_{F}-E_{i} ) at the surface is greater than ( E i − E F E i − E F E_(i)-E_(F)E_{i}-E_{F} ) in the bulk.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由于 n = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E F − E i ) / k T ] n = n i exp ⁡ E F − E i / k T n=n_(i)exp[(E_(F)-E_(i))//kT]n=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{F}-E_{i}\right) / k T\right] 和 p = n i exp ⁡ [ ( E i − E F ) / k T ] p = n i exp ⁡ E i − E F / k T p=n_(i)exp[(E_(i)-E_(F))//kT]p=n_{i} \exp \left[\left(E_{i}-E_{F}\right) / k T\right] ，（ E F − E i E F − E i E_(F)-E_(i)E_{F}-E_{i} ）在表面大于体内的（ E i − E F E i − E F E_(i)-E_(F)E_{i}-E_{F} ）。
◻ ◻ ◻\square If the gate voltage V G V G V_(G)V_{G} is increased further, the energy bands near the surface will try to bend downwards a bit more. This will cause ( E F − E i E F − E i E_(F)-E_(i)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}}-\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{i}} ) to increase, which will in turn cause the electron concentration n s n s n_(s)n_{s} in the inversion layer, and hence Q n Q n Q_(n)Q_{n} (made up of electrons) to increase rapidly. Thus, the incremental positive charge on the gate is balanced entirely by the incremental inversion charge. There is negligible increase in the depletion charge, and hence the depletion layer width W W WW does not increase further.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 如果栅极电压 V G V G V_(G)V_{G} 进一步增加，表面附近的能带将尝试向下弯曲更多。这将导致（ E F − E i E F − E i E_(F)-E_(i)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}}-\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{i}} ）增加，进而使反转层中的电子浓度 n s n s n_(s)n_{s} 增加，因此由电子组成的 Q n Q n Q_(n)Q_{n} 快速增加。这样，栅极上的增量正电荷完全由增量反转电荷平衡。耗尽电荷几乎没有增加，因此耗尽层宽度 W W WW 不再增加。

Definitions  定义

  1. Electric potential: ϕ ( x ) = E i ( bulk ) − E i ( x ) e ϕ ( x ) = E i (  bulk  ) − E i ( x ) e phi(x)=(E_(i)(" bulk ")-E_(i)(x))/(e)\phi(x)=\frac{E_{i}(\text { bulk })-E_{i}(x)}{e} where E i E i E_(i)E_{i} (bulk) is the intrinsic Fermi level in the bulk or interior of the Si , E i ( x ) E i ( x ) E_(i)(x)E_{i}(x) is the Intrinsic Ferm level at a point ( x x xx ).
    电势： ϕ ( x ) = E i ( bulk ) − E i ( x ) e ϕ ( x ) = E i (  bulk  ) − E i ( x ) e phi(x)=(E_(i)(" bulk ")-E_(i)(x))/(e)\phi(x)=\frac{E_{i}(\text { bulk })-E_{i}(x)}{e} ，其中 E i E i E_(i)E_{i} （体）是硅内部或体内的本征费米能级， E i ( x ) E i ( x ) E_(i)(x)E_{i}(x) 是在某点（ x x xx ）的本征费米能级。

2. 表面电势： ϕ s = E i ( bulk ) − E i ( x = 0 ) e ϕ s = E i (  bulk  ) − E i ( x = 0 ) e phi_(s)=(E_(i)(" bulk ")-E_(i)(x=0))/(e)\phi_{s}=\frac{E_{i}(\text { bulk })-E_{i}(x=0)}{e} 。
3. ϕ b = E i ( bulk ) − E F e ϕ b = E i (  bulk  ) − E F e phi_(b)=(E_(i)(" bulk ")-E_(F))/(e)\phi_{b}=\frac{E_{i}(\text { bulk })-E_{F}}{e}.
4. x d x d x_(d)x_{d} is the width of the depletion layer.
4. x d x d x_(d)x_{d} 是耗尽层的宽度。
Note: The symbol ) S S _(S){ }_{S} here refers to the potential at the surface of the semiconductor with respect to the bulk. It does not represent the semiconductor work function.

We begin the analysis ∗ ∗ ^(**){ }^{*} by using the depletion approximation. This assumes that :
我们开始通过使用耗尽近似来进行分析 ∗ ∗ ^(**){ }^{*} 。这假设：
  1. In the depletion region ( x < x d x < x d x < x_(d)x<x_{d} ), there are no mobile carriers (i.e., electrons and / or holes). The space charge is due entirely to ionised donors or acceptors only.
    在耗尽区（ x < x d x < x d x < x_(d)x<x_{d} ）内，没有移动载流子（即电子和/或空穴）。空间电荷完全由电离的施主或受主产生。

Threshold Voltage  阈值电压

We define the threshold voltage ( V T V T V_(T)V_{T} ) as the voltage applied to the gate of the MOS system just at the onset of strong inversion. We assume that at this point :
我们将阈值电压（ V T V T V_(T)V_{T} ）定义为施加在 MOS 系统栅极上的电压，刚好达到强反转的起始点。我们假设此时：
  1. The charge in the inversion layer is just going to be formed (i.e., the inversion charge is negligible compared to the charge in the depletion layer). We have thus assumed that the MOS system goes from the depletion mode directly into the strong inversion mode. Note that in making this assumption, we have neglected the intermediate state of weak inversion.
    反转层中的电荷刚刚形成（即反转电荷相对于耗尽层中的电荷可以忽略不计）。因此，我们假设 MOS 系统直接从耗尽模式进入强反转模式。注意，在做出此假设时，我们忽略了弱反转的中间状态。
  2. The width of the depletion layer has reached its maximum value. When the gate voltage exceeds the threshold voltage ( V G > V T V G > V T V_(G) > V_(T)V_{G}>V_{T} ), the inversion layer begins to form. Any additional charge added to the gate will be balanced by additional charge (electrons in this case) in the inversion layer, not by ionised acceptors (for p-type substrate) in the depletion layer. Hence the depletion layer will no longer grow wider.
    耗尽层的宽度已达到最大值。当栅极电压超过阈值电压（ V G > V T V G > V T V_(G) > V_(T)V_{G}>V_{T} ）时，反转层开始形成。任何额外加到栅极的电荷将由反转层中的额外电荷（此处为电子）平衡，而不是由耗尽层中的电离受主（对于 p 型衬底）平衡。因此，耗尽层将不再变宽。

通过将 ϕ s = 2 ϕ b ϕ s = 2 ϕ b phi_(s)=2phi_(b)\phi_{s}=2 \phi_{b} 代入方程(4.11)，我们得到耗尽层最大宽度的表达式：
x d T = ( 2 ε × 2 ϕ b e N A ) 1 / 2 = ( 4 ε ϕ b e N A ) 1 / 2 x d T = 2 ε × 2 ϕ b e N A 1 / 2 = 4 ε ϕ b e N A 1 / 2 x_(dT)=((2epsi xx2phi_(b))/(eN_(A)))^(1//2)=((4epsiphi_(b))/(eN_(A)))^(1//2)x_{d T}=\left(\frac{2 \varepsilon \times 2 \phi_{b}}{e N_{A}}\right)^{1 / 2}=\left(\frac{4 \varepsilon \phi_{b}}{e N_{A}}\right)^{1 / 2}

5. Deviation from Ideal MOS Capacitor
5. 理想 MOS 电容的偏差

5.1. Work function difference
5.1. 功函数差异

◻ ◻ ◻\square In the ideal MOS capacitor, it is assumed that there is no difference between the metal work function and the semiconductor work function.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 在理想的 MOS 电容中，假设金属功函数和半导体功函数之间没有差异。
◻ ◻ ◻\square So, when the MOS system is first brought into contact at equilibrium, there is no movement of the metal and semiconductor Fermi levels relative to each other (since both are at the same level), and there is no transfer of charges between the metal and the semiconductor.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 因此，当 MOS 系统首次接触达到平衡时，金属和半导体的费米能级相对于彼此没有移动（因为两者处于相同水平），且金属与半导体之间没有电荷转移。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The energy bands, E C , E V , E i E C , E V , E i E_(C),E_(V),E_(i)E_{C}, E_{V}, E_{i} in the semiconductor are then flat when no voltage is applied to the gate. This is referred to as the flat band condition.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当没有电压施加到栅极时，半导体中的能带 E C , E V , E i E C , E V , E i E_(C),E_(V),E_(i)E_{C}, E_{V}, E_{i} 是平的。这被称为平带条件。
◻ ◻ ◻\square However, this is generally not true for all MOS systems. There is, generally, a difference in the work functions of the metal and the semiconductor in a MOS system.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 然而，这通常不适用于所有 MOS 系统。一般来说，MOS 系统中金属和半导体的功函数存在差异。
As an example, consider an MOS system consisting of an aluminium gate, silicon dioxide dielectric, and p-type silicon substrate.
例如，考虑一个由铝栅极、二氧化硅介电层和 p 型硅衬底组成的 MOS 系统。
  • Al work function : e Φ m = 4.28 eV e Φ m = 4.28 eV ePhi_(m)=4.28eVe \Phi_{m}=4.28 \mathrm{eV}
    铝的功函数： e Φ m = 4.28 eV e Φ m = 4.28 eV ePhi_(m)=4.28eVe \Phi_{m}=4.28 \mathrm{eV}
  • Si electron affinity : e χ = 4.01 eV χ = 4.01 eV chi=4.01eV\chi=4.01 \mathrm{eV}
    硅的电子亲和能：e χ = 4.01 eV χ = 4.01 eV chi=4.01eV\chi=4.01 \mathrm{eV}
  • SiO 2 SiO 2 SiO_(2)\mathrm{SiO}_{2} electron affinity : e χ i = 0.9 eV e χ i = 0.9 eV echi_(i)=0.9eV\mathrm{e} \chi_{i}=0.9 \mathrm{eV}
    SiO 2 SiO 2 SiO_(2)\mathrm{SiO}_{2} 的电子亲和能： e χ i = 0.9 eV e χ i = 0.9 eV echi_(i)=0.9eV\mathrm{e} \chi_{i}=0.9 \mathrm{eV}
  • Si work function : e Φ s = 5 eV e Φ s = 5 eV ePhi_(s)=5eVe \Phi_{\mathrm{s}}=5 \mathrm{eV} (depends on doping)
    硅的功函数： e Φ s = 5 eV e Φ s = 5 eV ePhi_(s)=5eVe \Phi_{\mathrm{s}}=5 \mathrm{eV} （取决于掺杂）
Work function difference between metal and silicon,
金属与硅之间的功函数差，
Φ m s = Φ m − Φ s = 4.28 − 5.0 = − 0.72 eV Φ m s = Φ m − Φ s = 4.28 − 5.0 = − 0.72 eV {:[Phi_(ms)=Phi_(m)-Phi_(s)],[=4.28-5.0=-0.72eV]:}\begin{aligned} & \Phi_{m s}=\Phi_{m}-\Phi_{s} \\ & =4.28-5.0=-0.72 \mathrm{eV} \end{aligned}

◻ ◻ ◻\square When the MOS system is brought into contact, at thermal equilibrium (zero volt between the metal gate and the Si substrate), the Si Fermi level has to move up relative to the metal Fermi level until they are aligned.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当 MOS 系统接触时，在热平衡状态下（金属栅极与硅衬底之间电压为零），硅的费米能级必须相对于金属费米能级上移，直到两者对齐。
◻ ◻ ◻\square As the Si Fermi level moves up, E C , E V , E i E C , E V , E i E_(C),E_(V),E_(i)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{C}}, \mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{V}}, \mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{i}} and the vacuum level in the bulk move up, but at the Si-oxide interface, band bending takes place to maintain continuity of the vacuum level. [1]
◻ ◻ ◻\square 随着硅费米能级上移， E C , E V , E i E C , E V , E i E_(C),E_(V),E_(i)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{C}}, \mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{V}}, \mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{i}} 以及体内的真空能级也上移，但在硅-氧化物界面处，为了保持真空能级的连续性，发生了能带弯曲。[1]
  • Charge transfer takes place between the metal gate and Si substrate, [ 1 ] [ 1 ] ^([1]){ }^{[1]} and there is a potential drop across the oxide.
    金属栅极与硅衬底之间发生电荷转移， [ 1 ] [ 1 ] ^([1]){ }^{[1]} 并且氧化物层上存在电势降。
    [1] The principle is similar to that in a metal-semiconductor contact, except that in this case, charge transfer cannot take place across the oxide, which is (assumed to be) a perfect insulator, but between the gate and the contact to the back of the Si substrate.
    [1] 原理类似于金属-半导体接触，但在此情况下，电荷转移不能穿过氧化物（假设其为理想绝缘体），而是在栅极与硅衬底背面接触之间进行。
Energy band diagram of an MOS system at thermal equilibrium (zero volt applied between gate and substrate).
MOS 系统在热平衡状态下的能带图（栅极与衬底之间无电压施加）。

MOS 系统在热平衡状态

MOS 系统在平带条件下
◻ ◻ ◻\square A voltage, V G = ϕ m − ϕ s = − 0.72 V V G = ϕ m − ϕ s = − 0.72 V V_(G)=phi_(m)-phi_(s)=-0.72VV_{G}=\phi_{m}-\phi_{s}=-0.72 \mathrm{~V} has to be applied to the gate to bring the energy bands in Si downwards, back to the flat band condition. This voltage is known as the flat band voltage, V F B V F B V_(FB)V_{F B}.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 需要施加一个电压， V G = ϕ m − ϕ s = − 0.72 V V G = ϕ m − ϕ s = − 0.72 V V_(G)=phi_(m)-phi_(s)=-0.72VV_{G}=\phi_{m}-\phi_{s}=-0.72 \mathrm{~V} ，到栅极，使硅中的能带向下移动，回到平带条件。这个电压称为平带电压， V F B V F B V_(FB)V_{F B} 。
Note : e Φ m ′ e Φ m ′ ePhi_(m)^(')e \Phi_{m}^{\prime} and e ′ x e ′ x e^(')xe^{\prime} x in the above figure are the modified metal work function and modified Si electron affinity, respectively, which are measured with reference to E C E C E_(C)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{C}} of the oxide, instead of the vacuum level.
注意：上图中的 e Φ m ′ e Φ m ′ ePhi_(m)^(')e \Phi_{m}^{\prime} 和 e ′ x e ′ x e^(')xe^{\prime} x 分别是修正后的金属功函数和修正后的硅电子亲和能，它们是相对于氧化物的 E C E C E_(C)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{C}} 而非真空能级来测量的。

5.2 Oxide charges  5.2 氧化层电荷

  • An ideal MOS capacitor assumes that there are no charges in the oxide or at the oxide-semiconductor interface. This implies that under any biasing condition the amount of charge on the metal adjacent to the oxide is equal to the amount (with opposite sign) of the induced charge in the semiconductor.
    理想的 MOS 电容假设氧化层或氧化层-半导体界面处没有电荷。这意味着在任何偏置条件下，靠近氧化层的金属上的电荷量与半导体中感应电荷的量（符号相反）相等。
  • However, in real situations, the oxide is not free of charges.
    然而，在实际情况下，氧化层并非没有电荷。

    ◻ ◻ ◻\square Four different types of charges in the oxide:
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 氧化层中有四种不同类型的电荷：
  • interface state (interface trapped) charge Q i t Q i t Q_(it)Q_{i t},
    界面态（界面俘获）电荷 Q i t Q i t Q_(it)Q_{i t} ，
  • fixed oxide charge Q f Q f Q_(f)Q_{f},
    固定氧化电荷 Q f Q f Q_(f)Q_{f} ，
  • oxide trapped charge Q o t Q o t Q_(ot)Q_{o t},
    氧化物陷阱电荷 Q o t Q o t Q_(ot)Q_{o t} ,
  • mobile ionic charge Q M Q M Q_(M)Q_{M}.
    移动离子电荷 Q M Q M Q_(M)Q_{M} 。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square The amount of charges range from ∼ 10 10 cm − 2 ∼ 10 10 cm − 2 ∼10^(10)cm^(-2)\sim 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm}^{-2} to 10 12 cm − 2 10 12 cm − 2 10^(12)cm^(-2)10^{12} \mathrm{~cm}^{-2}, depending on processing conditions, contamination levels and other factors during the fabrication of the MOS device.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 电荷数量范围从 ∼ 10 10 cm − 2 ∼ 10 10 cm − 2 ∼10^(10)cm^(-2)\sim 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm}^{-2} 到 10 12 cm − 2 10 12 cm − 2 10^(12)cm^(-2)10^{12} \mathrm{~cm}^{-2} ，取决于工艺条件、污染水平及 MOS 器件制造过程中的其他因素。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square When the charges are located nearer to the silicon interface, it is more effective in modifying the surface potential in the silicon.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 当电荷位于更靠近硅界面时，对改变硅表面电势的效果更显著。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square Therefore, for simplicity, we assume in the analysis that a total equivalent oxide charge per unit area Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s} is located in the oxide directly adjacent to the oxidesilicon interface.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 因此，为了简化分析，我们假设单位面积的总等效氧化物电荷 Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s} 位于紧邻氧化物-硅界面的氧化物中。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square This Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s} will induce an equal (but opposite in sign) charge Q D Q D Q_(D)Q_{D} in the depletion layer of Si , thus leading to band bending in the Si .
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 该 Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s} 将在硅的耗尽层中感应出等量（但符号相反）的电荷 Q D Q D Q_(D)Q_{D} ，从而导致硅中的能带弯曲。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square To counter the effect of Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s}, a voltage V G V G V_(G)V_{G} has to be applied to the metal gate to deposit a charge Q m Q m Q_(m)Q_{m}, which is equal to (but opposite in sign) to Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s}. This will reduce the depletion layer charge in the Si to zero, thus bringing it back to the flat band condition.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 为了抵消 Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s} 的影响，必须在金属栅极上施加电压 V G V G V_(G)V_{G} ，以注入电荷 Q m Q m Q_(m)Q_{m} ，其大小等于（但符号相反于） Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s} 。这将使硅中的耗尽层电荷降为零，从而恢复到平带条件。
When the MOS system has been restored to flat band condition, there is no voltage drop in the silicon substrate. Therefore the voltage applied to the gate is equal to the voltage drop across the oxide, V o x V o x V_(ox)V_{o x}.
当 MOS 系统恢复到平带条件时，硅衬底中没有电压降。因此，施加在栅极上的电压等于氧化层上的电压降 V o x V o x V_(ox)V_{o x} 。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Hence, at flat band condition when there is an equivalent oxide charge Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s},
◻ ◻ ◻\square 因此，在平带条件下，当存在等效氧化物电荷 Q s s Q s s Q_(ss)Q_{s s} 时，
V G = V o x = Q m C o x = − Q s s C o x V G = V o x = Q m C o x = − Q s s C o x V_(G)=V_(ox)=(Q_(m))/(C_(ox))=(-Q_(ss))/(C_(ox))V_{G}=V_{o x}=\frac{Q_{m}}{C_{o x}}=\frac{-Q_{s s}}{C_{o x}}
  • When both work function difference and (positive) equivalent oxide charge exists, the voltage need to bring the MOS system to the flat band condition,
    当存在功函数差和（正）等效氧化物电荷时，使 MOS 系统达到平带条件所需的电压，
V F B = ϕ m s − Q s s C o x V F B = ϕ m s − Q s s C o x V_(FB)=phi_(ms)-(Q_(ss))/(C_(ox))V_{F B}=\phi_{m s}-\frac{Q_{s s}}{C_{o x}}
◻ ◻ ◻\square The expression for the metal-oxide-§-semiconductor capacitor in eqn (4.19) is modified to take into account the above non-idealities :
◻ ◻ ◻\square 金属-氧化物-半导体电容器在方程（4.19）中的表达式被修改以考虑上述非理想因素：
V T ( actual ) = V F B + 2 e ε N A ϕ b C o x + 2 ϕ b V T (  actual  ) = V F B + 2 e ε N A ϕ b C o x + 2 ϕ b V_(T)(" actual ")=V_(FB)+(2sqrt(e epsiN_(A)phi_(b)))/(C_(ox))+2phi_(b)V_{T}(\text { actual })=V_{F B}+\frac{2 \sqrt{e \varepsilon N_{A} \phi_{b}}}{C_{o x}}+2 \phi_{b}
i.e. V T ( V T ( quadV_(T)(\quad V_{T}( actual ) = ϕ m s − Q ss C o x + 2 e ε N A ϕ b C o x + 2 ϕ b ) = ϕ m s − Q ss C o x + 2 e ε N A ϕ b C o x + 2 ϕ b )=phi_(ms)-(Q_(ss))/(C_(ox))+(2sqrt(e epsiN_(A)phi_(b)))/(C_(ox))+2phi_(b))=\phi_{m \mathrm{~s}}-\frac{Q_{\mathrm{ss}}}{C_{o x}}+\frac{2 \sqrt{e \varepsilon N_{A} \phi_{b}}}{C_{o x}}+2 \phi_{b}.
即 V T ( V T ( quadV_(T)(\quad V_{T}( 实际的 ) = ϕ m s − Q ss C o x + 2 e ε N A ϕ b C o x + 2 ϕ b ) = ϕ m s − Q ss C o x + 2 e ε N A ϕ b C o x + 2 ϕ b )=phi_(ms)-(Q_(ss))/(C_(ox))+(2sqrt(e epsiN_(A)phi_(b)))/(C_(ox))+2phi_(b))=\phi_{m \mathrm{~s}}-\frac{Q_{\mathrm{ss}}}{C_{o x}}+\frac{2 \sqrt{e \varepsilon N_{A} \phi_{b}}}{C_{o x}}+2 \phi_{b} 。

Surface band bending at the onset of strong inversion

MOS Capacitor with n-type
具有 n 型的 MOS 电容器

substrate  衬底

◻ ◻ ◻\square For the MOS capacitor with an ntype substrate, the derivation of the threshold voltage is similar to that for a p-type substrate. Inversion occurs when a negative voltage whose magnitude is greater than the magnitude of the threshold voltage (negative) is applied to the gate. The energy bands in the semiconductor bend upwards, and the surface potential ϕ s ϕ s phi_(s)\phi_{s} is negative.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 对于具有 n 型衬底的 MOS 电容器，阈值电压的推导与 p 型衬底类似。当施加在栅极上的负电压的幅值大于阈值电压（负值）的幅值时，发生反转。半导体中的能带向上弯曲，表面电势 ϕ s ϕ s phi_(s)\phi_{s} 为负。

V T ( actual ) = ϕ M S − Q s s C o x − 2 e ε N D ϕ b C o x − 2 ϕ b V T (  actual  ) = ϕ M S − Q s s C o x − 2 e ε N D ϕ b C o x − 2 ϕ b V_(T)(" actual ")=phi_(MS)-(Q_(ss))/(C_(ox))-(2sqrt(e epsiN_(D)phi_(b)))/(C_(ox))-2phi_(b)V_{T}(\text { actual })=\phi_{M S}-\frac{Q_{s s}}{C_{o x}}-\frac{2 \sqrt{e \varepsilon N_{D} \phi_{b}}}{C_{o x}}-2 \phi_{b}
  • Note that in all the equations in the derivation of the threshold voltage, for both p-and n-type Si substrates, C o x C o x C_(ox)C_{o x} is the oxide capacitance per unit area, and has the unit of F cm − 2 F cm − 2 Fcm^(-2)\mathrm{F} \mathrm{cm}^{-2}.
    注意，在阈值电压推导的所有方程中，对于 p 型和 n 型硅衬底， C o x C o x C_(ox)C_{o x} 是单位面积的氧化层电容，单位为 F cm − 2 F cm − 2 Fcm^(-2)\mathrm{F} \mathrm{cm}^{-2} 。

6. Capacitance-Voltage characteristics
6. 电容-电压特性

◻ ◻ ◻\square The small signal capacitance C C CC (per unit cross-sectional area) of a device is defined as the differential change in the magnitude of the charge, d Q d Q dQd Q, on one plate, as a function of the differential change in the voltage d V d V dVd V across the device, i.e.,
◻ ◻ ◻\square 器件的小信号电容 C C CC （单位横截面积）定义为一极板上的电荷量 d Q d Q dQd Q 对器件两端电压 d V d V dVd V 微小变化的微分变化，即，
C = d Q d V C = d Q d V C=(dQ)/(dV)C=\frac{d Q}{d V}
◻ ◻ ◻\square The capacitance is a small signal or ac parameter. It is measured by superimposing a small ac measurement voltage on an applied dc gate bias voltage. The capacitance is then measured as a function of the applied dc gate voltage.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 电容是一个小信号或交流参数。通过在施加的直流栅极偏压上叠加一个小的交流测量电压来测量电容。然后测量电容随施加的直流栅极电压的变化。

6.1 Accumulation ( V G < 0 V G < 0 V_(G) < 0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}}<0 for p-type semiconductor)
6.1 载积（p 型半导体的 V G < 0 V G < 0 V_(G) < 0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}}<0 ）


◻ ◻ ◻\square A small differential change in voltage, d V d V dVd V, applied across the MOS structure will cause a differential change in charge dQ’ on the metal gate and also in the hole accumulation charge in the semiconductor.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 在 MOS 结构上施加一个微小的电压微分变化 d V d V dVd V ，将导致金属栅极上的电荷 dQ'以及半导体中空穴载积电荷的微分变化。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The differential changes in charge density occur at the edges of the oxide. This is similar to the situation in a parallel plate capacitor. Therefore, the accumulation capacitance per unit area, C a c c = C o x = ε o x t o x C a c c = C o x = ε o x t o x C_(acc)=C_(ox)=(epsi_(ox))/(t_(ox))C_{a c c}=C_{o x}=\frac{\varepsilon_{o x}}{t_{o x}}, where t o x t o x t_(ox)t_{o x} is the oxide thickness and ε o x ε o x epsi_(ox)\varepsilon_{o x} is
◻ ◻ ◻\square 电荷密度的微分变化发生在氧化层的边缘。这类似于平行板电容器的情况。因此，单位面积的载积电容为 C a c c = C o x = ε o x t o x C a c c = C o x = ε o x t o x C_(acc)=C_(ox)=(epsi_(ox))/(t_(ox))C_{a c c}=C_{o x}=\frac{\varepsilon_{o x}}{t_{o x}} ，其中 t o x t o x t_(ox)t_{o x} 是氧化层厚度， ε o x ε o x epsi_(ox)\varepsilon_{o x} 是
the permittivity of the oxide.
氧化层的介电常数。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Accumulation involves the movement of majority carriers in the semiconductor which can respond (i.e., increase or decrease) rapidly to the ac measurement voltage.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 载流子积累涉及半导体中多数载流子的运动，这些载流子可以快速响应（即增加或减少）交流测量电压。

6.2 Depletion ( V G ― > 0 V G _ > 0 V_(G_) > 0V_{\underline{G}}>0 for p-type semiconductor)
6.2 耗尽（ V G ― > 0 V G _ > 0 V_(G_) > 0V_{\underline{G}}>0 对于 p 型半导体）

(b)  （b）
◻ ◻ ◻\square In the depletion mode, a positive bias voltage applied to the gate causes holes in the semiconductor to be repelled from the edge of the depletion layer.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 在耗尽模式下，施加于栅极的正偏压使半导体中的空穴从耗尽层边缘被排斥。
◻ ◻ ◻\square A differential change in the gate voltage, d V d V dVd V, will cause a differential change in the width, d x d x dxd x, of the depletion layer, resulting in a differential charge d Q d Q dQd Q ’ at the edge of the depletion layer in the semiconductor.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 栅极电压的微分变化， d V d V dVd V ，将导致耗尽层宽度的微分变化， d x d x dxd x ，从而在半导体耗尽层边缘产生微分电荷 d Q d Q dQd Q ’。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The total depletion capacitance of the MOS capacitor, C ′ depl C ′ depl  C^(')_("depl ")\mathrm{C}^{\prime}{ }_{\text {depl }}, is the series combination of the oxide capacitance C O X C O X C_(OX)C_{O X} and the semiconductor (silicon, in this example) depletion capacitance C Si C Si  C_("Si ")C_{\text {Si }}.

oxide capacitance, C o x = ε o x t o x C o x = ε o x t o x C_(ox)=(epsi_(ox))/(t_(ox))C_{o x}=\frac{\varepsilon_{o x}}{t_{o x}},

x d x d x_(d)x_{d} 是硅中耗尽层的宽度， ε S i = ε 0 ε r , S i ε S i = ε 0 ε r , S i epsi_(Si)=epsi_(0)epsi_(r,Si)\varepsilon_{S i}=\varepsilon_{0} \varepsilon_{r, S i} 是硅的介电常数。
◻ x d ◻ x d ◻x_(d)\square x_{d} is a function of the gate bias voltage, V G V G V_(G)V_{G}. As V G V G V_(G)V_{G} is creased, x d x d x_(d)x_{d} increases, C S i C S i C_(Si)C_{S i} and hence the MOS depletion capacitance C depl ′ C depl  ′ C_("depl ")^(')C_{\text {depl }}^{\prime} decreases.
◻ x d ◻ x d ◻x_(d)\square x_{d} 是栅极偏压电压 V G V G V_(G)V_{G} 的函数。随着 V G V G V_(G)V_{G} 增加， x d x d x_(d)x_{d} 增大， C S i C S i C_(Si)C_{S i} ，因此 MOS 耗尽电容 C depl ′ C depl  ′ C_("depl ")^(')C_{\text {depl }}^{\prime} 减小。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The differential charge at the edge of the depletion layer of the silicon, d Q d Q dQd Q, is due to the movement of majority carriers (holes in this case) into or out of the edge of the depletion layer. The change in the differential charge can therefore take place very quickly, i.e., it can respond rapidly to the ac measurement voltage.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 硅耗尽层边缘的微分电荷 d Q d Q dQd Q 是由于多数载流子（此处为空穴）向耗尽层边缘的移动引起的。微分电荷的变化因此可以非常迅速地发生，即它可以快速响应交流测量电压。

6.3 Inversion ( V G ≫ 0 V G ≫ 0 V_(G)≫0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}} \gg 0 for p-type semiconductor)
6.3 反转（针对 P 型半导体的 V G ≫ 0 V G ≫ 0 V_(G)≫0\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{G}} \gg 0 ）

◻ ◻ ◻\square When the gate bias voltage is greater than the threshold voltage, an inversion layer (consisting of electrons, in this case, when the semiconductor substrate is p-type) is formed in the semiconductor near the oxide-semiconductor interface.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当栅极偏置电压大于阈值电压时，在半导体靠近氧化物-半导体界面处形成反转层（在本例中，当半导体基底为 p 型时，反转层由电子组成）。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The formation of the inversion charge is due to thermal generation of the minority carriers (electrons in the case of a p-type semiconductor). It is a relatively slow process.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 反转电荷的形成是由于少数载流子（在 p 型半导体中为电子）的热生成。这是一个相对较慢的过程。
◻ ◻ ◻\square If the ac measurement voltage across the MOS capacitor changes slowly, there is enough time for the minority carriers to be thermally generated. Then, the addition of a differential charge + d Q + d Q +dQ+d Q ’ on the gate, for example, will be balanced by the addition of a differential charge − d Q − d Q -dQ-d Q ‘, consisting of electrons, in the inversion layer.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 如果跨越 MOS 电容器的交流测量电压变化缓慢，有足够的时间让少数载流子热生成。然后，例如，栅极上差分电荷 + d Q + d Q +dQ+d Q ’的增加将被反转层中由电子组成的差分电荷 − d Q − d Q -dQ-d Q ’的增加所平衡。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Since the differential charges occur on both sides of the oxide, the inversion capacitance in this case is the oxide capacitance, i.e., C inv ′ = C o x C inv  ′ = C o x C_("inv ")^(')=C_(ox)C_{\text {inv }}^{\prime}=C_{o x}.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由于差分电荷出现在氧化物的两侧，在这种情况下反转电容即为氧化物电容，即 C inv ′ = C o x C inv  ′ = C o x C_("inv ")^(')=C_(ox)C_{\text {inv }}^{\prime}=C_{o x} 。

(a)  （a）

(b)  （b）
◻ ◻ ◻\square If the frequency of the ac measurement voltage is high, i.e., if the ac measurement voltage d V d V dVd V changes rapidly, then there is not enough time for minority carriers (electrons in this example) to be thermally generated.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 如果交流测量电压的频率很高，即交流测量电压 d V d V dVd V 变化迅速，那么少数载流子（此例中为电子）没有足够的时间通过热激发产生。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The addition of a differential charge +dQ’ on the gate, for example, will not be balanced by the addition of a differential charge − d Q − d Q -dQ-d Q ', consisting of electrons, in the inversion layer.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 例如，在栅极上增加一个微分电荷+dQ'，不会被反转层中由电子组成的微分电荷 − d Q − d Q -dQ-d Q '所平衡。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Instead, majority carriers (holes in this example), will be repelled away from the edge of the depletion layer, to leave behind ionised acceptors − d Q − d Q -dQ-d Q ’ that will balance the differential charge of + d Q + d Q +dQ+d Q ’ applied to the gate.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 相反，多数载流子（此例中为空穴）将被从耗尽层边缘排斥开，留下电离的受主 − d Q − d Q -dQ-d Q '，以平衡施加在栅极上的微分电荷 + d Q + d Q +dQ+d Q '。
◻ ◻ ◻\square This situation is similar to that under the depletion condition, but with depletion layer at its maximum width of x d T x d T x_(dT)x_{d T}, which it reached when the MOS system went into inversion.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 这种情况类似于耗尽状态，但耗尽层宽度达到最大值 x d T x d T x_(dT)x_{d T} ，这是 MOS 系统进入反转时达到的宽度。

◻ ◻ ◻\square The value of the differential capacitance of the MOS capacitor in the inversion regime therefore depends on the frequency of the measurement ac voltage.
MOS 电容器在反转区的微分电容值因此取决于测量交流电压的频率。
If the measurement frequency is low, C ′ Inv = C OX C ′ Inv  = C OX  C^(')_("Inv ")=C_("OX ")C^{\prime}{ }_{\text {Inv }}=C_{\text {OX }}.
如果测量频率较低， C ′ Inv = C OX C ′ Inv  = C OX  C^(')_("Inv ")=C_("OX ")C^{\prime}{ }_{\text {Inv }}=C_{\text {OX }} 。
If the measurement frequency is high, C i n v ′ = C o x × C S i C o x + C S i C i n v ′ = C o x × C S i C o x + C S i C_(inv)^(')=(C_(ox)xxC_(Si))/(C_(ox)+C_(Si))C_{i n v}^{\prime}=\frac{C_{o x} \times C_{S i}}{C_{o x}+C_{S i}} where the silicon capacitance at inversion, C S i = ε S i x d T , x d T C S i = ε S i x d T , x d T C_(Si)=(epsi_(Si))/(x_(dT)),quadx_(dT)C_{S i}=\frac{\varepsilon_{S i}}{x_{d T}}, \quad x_{d T} being the maximum depletion layer width,
如果测量频率较高， C i n v ′ = C o x × C S i C o x + C S i C i n v ′ = C o x × C S i C o x + C S i C_(inv)^(')=(C_(ox)xxC_(Si))/(C_(ox)+C_(Si))C_{i n v}^{\prime}=\frac{C_{o x} \times C_{S i}}{C_{o x}+C_{S i}} ，其中反转时的硅电容为 C S i = ε S i x d T , x d T C S i = ε S i x d T , x d T C_(Si)=(epsi_(Si))/(x_(dT)),quadx_(dT)C_{S i}=\frac{\varepsilon_{S i}}{x_{d T}}, \quad x_{d T} ，为最大耗尽层宽度，
